lines.en: I've walked this path a hundred years.
My joints creak beneath my robe.
My shoe sinks into wet mud.

lines.zh: 我手里的药瓶，是浑浊的。
lines.en: The flask in my hand is cloudy.
The grass withers where I step.
My hat has slipped and I cannot be bothered.
My robe drags across a row of graves.
I skirt a patch of freshly turned earth.
My staff feels the way for me.
Moonlight rests on my hat.
I walk slowly, and the mist follows.
There's a light ahead. I won't go.

lines.zh: 我忘的好像是你的名字。
lines.en: What I forgot may be your name.
A spark still glows in the ash.

lines.zh: 生前我喜欢坐在这个角落。
lines.en: In life I liked sitting in this corner.

lines.zh: 我这身紫袍，已经长满幽匿。
lines.en: Sculk has grown over this purple robe.
I'll stand here till the world rots.
I shake the potion flask.
My hem drags mycelium behind it.

lines.zh: 女巫的符文泡在幽匿里。
lines.en: The witch's runes soak in sculk.
Mycelium drips from my hat brim.
I wait for the moon to lean west.

lines.zh: 你站在我煮药的下风口。
lines.en: You stand downwind of my brew.
A sculk witch's potions carry fungus too.
Your armor is covered in dust.

lines.zh: 你的火把照得菌丝发白。
lines.en: Your torch bleaches the mycelium white.
I search your face for someone I knew.
Fungus hasn't touched your eyes yet.

lines.zh: 幽匿的女巫，还记得祭坛。
lines.en: The sculk witch still remembers the altar.
You still carry body warmth.
Your shadow falls into my cauldron.

lines.zh: 我的药瓶，装的是幽匿汁。
lines.en: My bottles hold sculk juice.
You've soiled my robe.
One potion flask has shattered.
I steady myself on my staff.
Green water seeps from my bones.

lines.zh: 我只有十点血，可我会跑。
lines.en: Ten points only, but I can run.
My hat brim is broken.
The mycelium recoils from the wound.
My spell breaks off mid-verse.
All my potion bottles are broken.
My hand is gone; I can still walk.
Let me smell it. I won't snatch.
That fruit has soaked in my brew.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，让我想起生前。
lines.en: Rotten flesh reminds me of being alive.
There's warmth in your hand.
My cauldron lacks exactly this.
My tongue lost all feeling long ago.
This one goes into my sleeve first.

lines.zh: 十点血的女巫，也会诅咒。
lines.en: A ten-health witch still curses.

lines.zh: 我的袍角垂到地上，全湿了。
lines.en: My robe hem hangs to the ground, soaked.
That rot smell drifting over — familiar.
My bottles are filled with sculk.
Your arm scatters my fungus.
Bumping me — is that a taunt?
Don't shove. My bones won't hold.
Don't shove. My bones are creaking.
You're standing on my robe.
Bumping you — my apology comes late.
My hat slides to one side.
I nearly dropped my flask.
My sleeve brushes your hand.

lines.zh: 我把骨杖靠在你的旁边。
lines.en: I lean my staff beside yours.
The brew I stir is sculk-colored.

lines.zh: 你要是也成了幽匿，就并排吧。
lines.en: If you turn sculk too, we'll stand side by side.

lines.zh: 我的药锅可以分你一半。
lines.en: You can have half my cauldron.

lines.zh: 等菌长满，我们就不分了。
lines.en: When the fungus fills in, we won't be apart.
Two graves side by side keep out the cold.

lines.zh: 我的药瓶里，装的是幽匿。
lines.en: My bottles hold sculk, not potion.

lines.zh: 我的帽子歪了，没人替我扶。
lines.en: My hat's crooked and no one fixes it.
You're unfinished too. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我记不住从前，只记得你。
lines.en: I forget the past, but not you.
Can this trade for a potion?
This cloth is soaked with living sweat.
I wipe it clean with my sleeve.
One more ingredient in the flask.
Bone? No, a sculk stick.
Two things in my hands at last.
What I brew is a pot of fungus.
A finger bone, still good for brewing.
Who left a rune by the grave?
I drop it into the cauldron.

lines.zh: 我的药瓶里装的不是药，是孢子。
lines.en: My bottles hold spores, not potions.

lines.zh: 十点血的女巫，药水还够。
lines.en: A ten-point witch still has potions left.
I pull the stopper from the flask.
My bottles hold sculk.

lines.zh: 幽匿锅里的东西，心跳太响。
lines.en: Something in my sculk pot has a loud heart.
Run — my potion will wait.
The sculk pointed you out to me.
You've walked right into my circle.
Spores settle on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 幽匿底下，没有活人能站住。
lines.en: Under the sculk, no living thing stands.
This body smells living breath.

lines.zh: 我的骨杖一指，地就变蓝。
lines.en: One point of my staff and the ground turns blue.
The fire under my cauldron flares.
My bone staff points at you.
I've seen you. You won't leave.
You snap a dry bone underfoot.
Your warmth stands out.

lines.zh: 女巫的袍子，已经和菌丝长在一起。
lines.en: My robe has grown into the mycelium.
The more you hurry, the stickier the spores.
I smell the mud on your boots.

lines.zh: 锅里的东西已经不冒泡了。
lines.en: Nothing bubbles in my cauldron now.

lines.zh: 我骨杖上的菌，比药还毒。
lines.en: The fungus on my staff is worse than any potion.
I needn't chase. The brew drifts to you.

lines.zh: 光里我也不怕，只是不喜欢。
lines.en: Light doesn't stop me — I just dislike it.
Mycelium tangles around your feet for me.
My robe hem sweeps over the graves.
My cauldron still bubbles green.

lines.zh: 我的药水瓶里装的是孢子。
lines.en: My bottles hold spores, not potions.
The more you run, the hungrier the sculk.
All these graves answer to me.
The mist ahead is mine, brewed by me.

lines.zh: 幽匿女巫的药，正慢慢熬。
lines.en: The sculk witch's brew is still simmering.
Pause a moment. Let me look at you.
My staff taps the ground, and the grass dies.
The ground turns blue where you run.
Turn around. Look at my face.

lines.zh: 我的兜帽里，菌丝缠成一团。
lines.en: Mycelium tangles in a knot under my hood.

lines.zh: 我锅里熬的，是绿色的汤。
lines.en: What simmers in my cauldron is a green broth.
Mycelium binds your wrist.
You've breathed in a lungful of green smoke.
Don't fall yet. The brew isn't done.
My staff cracks against your knee.
I step back and add another blow.
Move; the cauldron is still hot.
My nail slices open your sleeve.
This lands faster than a potion.
This staff blow is not a light one.
My chant carries mycelium.
My grip is stronger than it looks.
This staff blow carries spores.

lines.zh: 我扔出去的药瓶，也是蓝的。
lines.en: Even the bottles I throw are blue.
The flask shatters at your feet.
You cough. That's right.
My bone staff rises first.
This hat presses down on the mycelium.
The potion flask still hangs at my waist.
Sculk pieced the altar back together.
I work my stiff knuckles.
Sculk grows on my hat.

lines.zh: 十点血，摇摇晃晃也能站。
lines.en: Ten health, and I still wobble upright.

lines.zh: 我扔出的东西，会自己爬。
lines.en: What I throw crawls on its own.
The chorus underground has stopped.
The witch's robes are caked with sculk.
Altar ash settles over my face.
I open my eyes to graves.

lines.zh: 复活的味道，和幽匿一样。
lines.en: Resurrection tastes like sculk.
Sculk crawls out from under my robe.
Fire climbs along my sleeve.

lines.zh: 幽匿的袍子，摔下来很轻。
lines.en: These sculk robes fall lightly.
The potion spilled, and the sculk thinned.
The blast overturns my cauldron.
An arrow pins me to a gravestone.
The spell scorches my fungus.
The cauldron's empty, and so is my stomach.
The lightning scorched my robe.
Not even fungus survives the void.
